## Checklist

- [ ] `composer lint && composer test` pass
- [ ] `npm run lint && npm test` pass
- [ ] The title follows Conventional Commits (`feat(grid): …`, `fix(a11y): …`): see CONTRIBUTING.md
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md has a line under `[Unreleased]` (if users will notice the change)
- [ ] New components have a fixture in `tests/js/fixtures/build.php` (axe-core)
- [ ] Docs updated (README, PHPDoc of public methods, examples)
- [ ] New libraries are MIT/Apache/BSD and listed in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`
